items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: And Peckin' Joe -- I called him good buddy, too, you see

ctx.x: Chuck, I just want to say one more time, as Duke would say, when you saw Peckin' Joe in the hospital and he showed you the step, did it at all remind you of Freddy James?

Well, I must agree with that question. It's a very good question, because they were -- I'd say we were all in the same parade. The tap dancers were the tap dancers, you see, and it was just their student body, you see, and they all tried to graduate, you know, or enlarge their degrees, see.
